app_fee.value: The department's guidelines give the application cost as $85.

fee_waiver.value: The $85 fee can be waived for applicants for whom it is a financial burden; the sentence sets no nationality limit.
fee_waiver.quote: this cost can be waived for applicants for whom this fee represents a financial burden

deadline.value: Applications are due December 1, 2026 for fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: The deadline for applications is December 1st of each year

supervisor.value: Applicants need a faculty sponsor in the department, except rotation-fellowship applicants.
supervisor.quote: Application to our program requires students to be sponsored by faculty within our department, unless they are pursuing a rotation fellowship

funding.value: Admitted PhD students are guaranteed 10 semesters of support as a teaching or research assistant.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. program in the Department of Biology are guaranteed 10 semesters of support

gre_general.value: The department's application guidelines do not mention the GRE.

entry_route.value: The guidelines do not say whether a master's is needed for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: The Biology Academic Bulletin page returned HTTP 502, so the bulletin's December 1 date is not quoted. The Biology PhD also has a rotation-fellowship route for applicants without a sponsor.
